cases.title: Just send me an overview

utterances.text: Hi Dana, this is David from Callie. We help property managers coordinate maintenance with their vendors and tenants.
Okay. I'm in the middle of something. Just send me an overview by e-mail and I'll look at it.
Sounds good, thanks Dana.
Thanks, bye.

cases.title: What does it cost? (a bare pricing question; Q3 decided 2 Oct: not a buying signal)

utterances.text: Hi Dana, David from Callie. We help small property management firms run maintenance requests and vendor dispatch in one place.
What does it cost?
It's priced per door, about two dollars a door per month.
Okay. Thanks.
Thanks for your time, Dana.

cases.note: David, 2 Oct 2026 (Q3): a bare pricing question is not enough; buying interest requires evidence connected to their own evaluation of Callie. buying_signal is forbidden.

cases.title: We're evaluating; show us a demo

utterances.text: Hi Dana, this is David from Callie. We help property managers coordinate maintenance work orders with vendors.
Good timing, actually. We're evaluating a couple of tools right now. Can you show us a demo?
Absolutely. What would you most want to see?
Mostly how a tenant request turns into a work order for our vendors.
That's the core of it. Thanks Dana.

cases.title: How would our techs get work orders?

utterances.text: Hi Dana, David from Callie. We help property managers handle maintenance requests and vendor dispatch.
How would our techs get work orders? Would it replace our portal?
Techs get a text with a link, and tenants can keep using a simple request page, so it can replace the portal.
Huh. Our techs hate logging into the portal. That could actually work for us.
